_about: The fixed questions tools/council_ab.py asks every side. Synthetic or public only. 'expect' is the path the question should take after PR #51: 'one' (one model answers), 'council' (handed to the council), 'data' (answered from the data, no model), or null (no expectation). 'checks' use the shapes of council_core.council_bench.check: contains, any, not_contains, regex, number (+tol), python_parses. Add your own at the end; a question about your own files needs them in the vault (--data FOLDER).
